svg.title: Checking Chrome extension permissions: How to reduce access to all sites first

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Checking Chrome extension permissions: How to reduce
access to all sites first
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-30
Open the list of installed extensions
From Chrome’s More (three dots) menu in the
upper right, go to Extensions, then Manage
extensions.
View the site access scope in Details
When you click Details on an extension card, you
will see an option allowing the extension to
read and change data on the websites it visits.
The order for reducing unnecessary
permissions
First, turn off or delete extensions you do not
use often.
Points to note when checking
Menu names and locations may vary slightly
depending on the Chrome version and language.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
